cn_steps: 启用 `Game Input (Windows)` 插件（运行时模块 `GameInputWindows`），在 Windows 目标里可用。
在项目设置或初始化代码里调用 `GameInput` API 创建 device、注册回调，而不是走旧的 XInput / RawInput。
用统一的 device 接口读取手柄、键鼠等设备状态；同一套代码可映射到不同设备。
运行时游戏模块在 `Build.cs` 只依赖 `GameInputWindows`；非 Windows 平台不要直接依赖它。
en_steps: Enable `Game Input (Windows)` (runtime module `GameInputWindows`); it targets Windows.
Create devices and register callbacks through the `GameInput` API instead of legacy XInput / RawInput.
Read gamepad and mouse/keyboard state through the unified device interface so one code path maps to different devices.
At runtime depend on `GameInputWindows` via `Build.cs` only; do not depend on it on non-Windows platforms.
note_cn: 这是 Windows 上的新输入 API（GameInput）封装，不是 Enhanced Input 本身。
note_en: A Windows wrapper over the GameInput API, not Enhanced Input itself.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Gameplay Abilities Game Feature Actions`（模块 `AbilitySystemGameFeatureActions`）。
在 Game Feature 插件里添加 GAS 相关的 Game Feature Action，用它在 Feature 激活/停用时授予或移除 GameplayAbility。
让角色的 AbilitySystemComponent 通过 GameFeature 的 Add/Remove 流程取得技能，而不是手写 GrantAbility。
Experimental：接口随夜构建可能变化，先在空关卡验证 Feature 激活顺序。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Gameplay Abilities Game Feature Actions` (module `AbilitySystemGameFeatureActions`).
Inside a Game Feature plugin, add the GAS Game Feature Actions to grant/remove GameplayAbilities as the feature activates or deactivates.
Let the character's AbilitySystemComponent receive abilities through the GameFeature Add/Remove flow instead of hand-calling GrantAbility.
Experimental: the contract may shift on nightlies; prove feature activation order in an empty map first.
note_cn: 给 GAS 用的 Game Feature Action，真正的 GAS 核心在 `Gameplay Abilities` 插件。
note_en: Game Feature Actions for GAS; the actual GAS core lives in the `Gameplay Abilities` plugin.

cn_steps: 启用 `Gameplay Abilities`（运行时 `GameplayAbilities`，编辑器 `GameplayAbilitiesEditor`）。
在角色上挂 `AbilitySystemComponent` 与 `AttributeSet`，初始化属性与初始技能。
用 `GameplayAbility` 写攻击/翻滚等技能，用 `GameplayEffect` 做冷却、消耗、Buff，用 `GameplayCue` 加表现（特效/音效）。
多人玩法在服务器授予技能、客户端预测；Game 模块依赖 `GameplayAbilities`，`GameplayAbilitiesEditor` 只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Gameplay Abilities` (runtime `GameplayAbilities`, editor `GameplayAbilitiesEditor`).
Add an `AbilitySystemComponent` and an `AttributeSet` to the character and initialize attributes and starting abilities.
Author attacks/dodges as `GameplayAbility`, use `GameplayEffect` for cooldowns, costs, and buffs, and `GameplayCue` for VFX/SFX.
For multiplayer, grant on server and predict on client; depend on `GameplayAbilities` from game modules and keep `GameplayAbilitiesEditor` on Editor targets.
note_cn: GAS 数据驱动技能框架，支持复制；示例常用 Lyra 的 GAS 用法对照。
note_en: The data-driven GAS framework with replication; Lyra is a common reference implementation.

cn_steps: 启用 `Gameplay Cameras`（运行时 `GameplayCameras`，还有 `GameplayCamerasUncookedOnly` 与编辑器 `GameplayCamerasEditor`）。
用 `Camera Asset / Camera Rig` 搭建模块化相机：在 Camera Director 里选择当前激活的相机 rig。
把 Camera Director 组件挂到 Player Controller 或 Pawn，通过 Camera Node（偏移、注视、遮挡等）组合行为。
Game 模块依赖 `GameplayCameras`；`GameplayCamerasEditor` 只用于编辑器。
en_steps: Enable `Gameplay Cameras` (runtime `GameplayCameras`, plus `GameplayCamerasUncookedOnly` and editor `GameplayCamerasEditor`).
Build cameras modularly from `Camera Asset / Camera Rig` and pick the active rig through the Camera Director.
Attach the Camera Director component to the Player Controller or Pawn and compose behavior via Camera Nodes (offset, look-at, occlusion, etc.).
Game modules depend on `GameplayCameras`; `GameplayCamerasEditor` is editor-only.
note_cn: 模块化数据驱动相机系统（Gameplay Cameras 2.0），不是旧 Camera Component 直接挂载。
note_en: The modular data-driven camera system (Gameplay Cameras 2.0), not the classic Camera Component.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Gameplay Capture Interfaces`（模块 `GameplayCaptureInterfaces`）。
这是一个共享接口层：只有在编写 GameplayCapture 相关插件、需要与其互操作时才依赖它。
在模块 `Build.cs` 里依赖 `GameplayCaptureInterfaces`，实现/引用其中的接口，避免各 Capture 插件互相直接依赖。
普通玩法内容一般不直接用；Experimental，接口可能随夜构建变化。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Gameplay Capture Interfaces` (module `GameplayCaptureInterfaces`).
This is a shared interface layer: depend on it only when writing GameplayCapture-related plugins that must interoperate.
Add `GameplayCaptureInterfaces` to your module `Build.cs` and implement/reference its interfaces so capture plugins avoid depending on each other directly.
Normal gameplay content rarely touches it; it is Experimental and may change on nightlies.
note_cn: 面向插件作者的共享接口，不是可放置的 Gameplay 组件。
note_en: A shared interface for plugin authors, not a placeable gameplay component.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Gameplay Graph`（模块 `GameplayGraph`）。
在需要图结构（节点/边、寻路、依赖关系等）的玩法逻辑里，使用插件提供的图模型与常见图算法。
从模块 `Build.cs` 依赖 `GameplayGraph`，用其类型构建图并在运行时查询。
Experimental：算法接口可能随夜构建变化，别写死未文档化类型。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Gameplay Graph` (module `GameplayGraph`).
Use the provided graph model and common graph algorithms where gameplay needs node/edge data, pathing, or dependency graphs.
Depend on `GameplayGraph` from your module `Build.cs`, build graphs with its types, and query them at runtime.
Experimental: algorithm API may shift on nightlies; do not freeze undocumented types.
note_cn: 通用图模型与算法库，不是可视化的关卡工具。
note_en: A general graph model and algorithms library, not a visual level tool.

cn_steps: 启用 `Gameplay Messages`（运行时 `GameplayMessages`，编辑器 `GameplayMessagesEditor`）。
用它在系统之间做解耦的消息传递：定义消息并在合适时机广播，其他系统订阅处理。
编辑器里用 `GameplayMessagesEditor` 调试/查看消息；Game 模块只依赖 `GameplayMessages`。
它是轻量消息总线，不替代复制型网络 RPC；联网逻辑仍走正常的复制通道。
en_steps: Enable `Gameplay Messages` (runtime `GameplayMessages`, editor `GameplayMessagesEditor`).
Use it to decouple systems: define messages, broadcast at the right moment, and let other systems subscribe.
Use `GameplayMessagesEditor` for editor-side debugging/viewing; game modules depend on `GameplayMessages` only.
It is a lightweight message bus, not a replication RPC layer; networking still uses normal replication.
note_cn: 轻量玩法消息总线，用于解耦，不是网络 RPC。
note_en: A lightweight gameplay message bus for decoupling, not a network RPC layer.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Gameplay Tags Toolset`（模块 `GameplayTagsToolset`），它面向 AI Toolset Registry。
让 AI 助手/工具通过 Toolset Registry 调用它，读取或管理 Gameplay Tags，而不是手动改 ini。
在 `DefaultGameplayTags.ini` 已定义标签的前提下使用；工具集只做读取/管理接口。
这是给 AI 工具链用的 Toolset，不是游戏运行时给玩家用的功能。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Gameplay Tags Toolset` (module `GameplayTagsToolset`); it targets the AI Toolset Registry.
Let AI assistants/tools call it through the Toolset Registry to read or manage Gameplay Tags instead of hand-editing ini files.
Use it against tags already defined in `DefaultGameplayTags.ini`; the toolset only reads/manages them.
It is a toolset for the AI toolchain, not a player-facing runtime feature.
note_cn: AI 工具集注册表里的 GameplayTags 工具，不是运行时标签系统本身。
note_en: A GameplayTags tool inside the AI Toolset Registry, not the runtime tag system itself.

cn_steps: 启用 `GameplayBehaviorSmartObjects`（模块 `GameplayBehaviorSmartObjectsModule`）。
在关卡放置 Smart Object，并让它的默认运行时行为走 `GameplayBehavior`。
AI 或玩家通过 Smart Object 交互时，由 GameplayBehavior 驱动对应行为，而不是自定义 Claim/Release 逻辑。
需要基础 Smart Objects 能力，确保 Smart Objects 相关插件已启用；本插件只补 GameplayBehavior 行为层。
en_steps: Enable `GameplayBehaviorSmartObjects` (module `GameplayBehaviorSmartObjectsModule`).
Place Smart Objects in the level and make their default runtime behavior use `GameplayBehavior`.
When AI or players interact through the Smart Object, GameplayBehavior drives the behavior instead of custom claim/release logic.
Make sure the base Smart Objects plugins are enabled; this plugin only adds the GameplayBehavior behavior layer.
note_cn: 把 SmartObject 的运行时行为接到 GameplayBehavior，不是 SmartObject 框架本体。
note_en: Wires SmartObject runtime behavior to GameplayBehavior; it is not the SmartObject framework itself.

cn_steps: 启用 `GameplayInteractions`（模块 `GameplayInteractionsModule`）。
用它搭建玩家与 NPC / 世界对象之间的交互（交互点、状态机、进入/退出交互）。
把交互数据与 StateTree/行为配合：角色靠近交互目标时触发对应的交互任务。
交互逻辑是运行时玩法，Game 模块依赖 `GameplayInteractionsModule`。
en_steps: Enable `GameplayInteractions` (module `GameplayInteractionsModule`).
Use it to build player-to-NPC/world interactions (interaction points, state machine, enter/exit interaction).
Pair interaction data with StateTree/behavior so approaching an interaction target triggers the matching interaction task.
Interaction logic is runtime gameplay; game modules depend on `GameplayInteractionsModule`.
note_cn: 玩家/NPC 交互框架，常与 StateTree 搭配，不是单纯的 SmartObject。
note_en: A player/NPC interaction framework often paired with StateTree, distinct from SmartObject.

cn_steps: 启用 `GameplayStateTree`（模块 `GameplayStateTreeModule`）。
为角色/AI 创建 StateTree，在 StateTree 编辑器里用玩法任务、条件、过渡组织行为。
让控制器或 AI 组件运行该 StateTree 资产，由它驱动移动、交互、战斗等状态。
Game 模块依赖 `GameplayStateTreeModule`；它是 StateTree 框架的玩法扩展层。
en_steps: Enable `GameplayStateTree` (module `GameplayStateTreeModule`).
Create a StateTree for characters/AI and organize behavior with gameplay tasks, conditions, and transitions in the StateTree editor.
Have the controller or AI component run that StateTree asset to drive movement, interactions, combat, and other states.
Game modules depend on `GameplayStateTreeModule`; it is the gameplay extension layer over the StateTree framework.
note_cn: StateTree 的玩法/AI 扩展，不是 Mass 或行为树。
note_en: The gameplay/AI extension over StateTree, not Mass or Behavior Trees.

cn_steps: 启用编辑器插件 `GameplayTagsEditor`（模块 `GameplayTagsEditor`）并重启。
在 `Project Settings > Gameplay Tags` 或细节面板里用它提供的编辑器 UI 增删、重命名 Gameplay Tags。
用其蓝图节点/编辑器支持给资产和对象打标签；改完记得保存标签列表。
它是编辑器工具，只能进 Editor Target，不要写进 Game `Build.cs`。
en_steps: Enable the editor plugin `GameplayTagsEditor` (module `GameplayTagsEditor`) and restart.
Use its editor UI in `Project Settings > Gameplay Tags` or Details to add, rename, and remove Gameplay Tags.
Use its Blueprint nodes/editor support to tag assets and objects; save the tag list after edits.
It is an editor tool for Editor targets only; never add it to a game `Build.cs`.
note_cn: Gameplay Tags 的编辑器 UI/节点，运行时标签在别的模块。
note_en: Editor UI/nodes for Gameplay Tags; the runtime tag system lives elsewhere.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `GASToolsets`（模块 `GASToolsets`），它面向 AI Toolset Registry。
让 AI 助手通过 Toolset Registry 调用它来查询/操作 Gameplay Ability System（技能、效果等）。
在已启用 `Gameplay Abilities` 的前提下使用；Toolset 只是给工具链的接口层。
这是开发期工具集，不是玩家运行时功能；Experimental，接口可能变化。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `GASToolsets` (module `GASToolsets`); it targets the AI Toolset Registry.
Let AI assistants call it through the Toolset Registry to inspect/operate Gameplay Ability System data (abilities, effects, etc.).
Use it with `Gameplay Abilities` enabled; the toolset is an interface layer for tooling.
It is a development-time toolset, not a player runtime feature; Experimental and subject to change.
note_cn: 给 AI 工具链用的 GAS 工具集，不是 GAS 运行时。
note_en: A GAS toolset for the AI toolchain, not the GAS runtime.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Gauntlet`（模块 `Gauntlet`）。
用 Gauntlet 的控制器/辅助类在游戏里创建和管理自动化测试会话，跑构建与用例。
在命令行或自动化流水线里调用对应的 Gauntlet 目标，收集测试结果。
这是测试框架，不要打包进玩家版本；Experimental，接口可能随版本变化。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Gauntlet` (module `Gauntlet`).
Use Gauntlet's controller/helper classes to create and manage automated test sessions in your game, running builds and test cases.
Invoke the matching Gauntlet target from the command line or CI pipeline and collect the results.
It is a test framework; do not ship it to players; Experimental with a contract that may change.
note_cn: 自动化测试框架（配合运行/构建目标），不是游戏内玩法系统。
note_en: An automation test framework (with run/build targets), not an in-game gameplay system.

cn_steps: 启用 `Gaussian Splat`（运行时 `GaussianSplat`，另有 `GaussianSplatShader`、`GaussianSplatSceneViewExtension` 与 `GaussianSplatEditor`、Niagara 相关模块）。
导入或创建 Gaussian Splat 资产，把它放进关卡（或用 Niagara 版本驱动）。
确认目标平台支持 ES3.1+ 的渲染路径，PIE 里查看 splat 的显示效果。
游戏运行时依赖 `GaussianSplat`；`GaussianSplatEditor` 只用于编辑器。
en_steps: Enable `Gaussian Splat` (runtime `GaussianSplat`, plus `GaussianSplatShader`, `GaussianSplatSceneViewExtension`, `GaussianSplatEditor`, and Niagara modules).
Import or create a Gaussian Splat asset and place it in the level (or drive the Niagara variant).
Confirm the target platform supports the ES3.1+ rendering path and check the splat in PIE.
Game runtime depends on `GaussianSplat`; `GaussianSplatEditor` is editor-only.
note_cn: Gaussian Splat 资产与 ES3.1+ 渲染，需要相应 RHI/移动端支持。
note_en: Gaussian Splat assets and ES3.1+ rendering; requires the matching RHI/mobile support.
